description: Skattereduktion för förnybar el is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Skatteverket. Tax reduction for micro-generation of renewable electricity. Annual data. Number of taxpayers, number of kWh and amount. Coverage: Skatteverket. The portal shows the English title as "Tax reduction for renewable electricity" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Skatteverket. Its keywords include Stöd, Skatteverkets statistikportal, Kontrolluppgift, Skattereduktion, Inkomstdeklaration, Förnybar el. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
